observations: Two cast-iron treadle-style stands/legs for sewing machines, photographed outdoors on dirt/concrete ground.
Each stand has a wooden tabletop with a rectangular cutout where a sewing machine head would normally sit; no machine head is present in any photo.
A foot-pedal/treadle grille is visible under each table, and one photo (photo 3) shows a drive wheel on the iron frame.
Tabletops show different finishes: one plain wood-grain laminate, one blue/grey marbled laminate, suggesting two separate used units.
Visible surface rust and wear on the iron legs in several shots.
Watermarks 'Posted on Jiji' and 'SESHMAK TECH' overlay all images; no brand plate or model number is visible on the iron or wood.
No close-up of welds, joints, or the underside mechanism is provided.
